gaps.sentence: Could you look ___ my suitcase while I buy the tickets?
gaps.explanation: look after = take care of; look for = search; look up = check in a reference.

gaps.sentence: They get ___ on very little money.
gaps.explanation: get by = manage to survive (with difficulty).

gaps.sentence: I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: I ran ___ my old teacher at the airport.
gaps.explanation: run into somebody = meet them by chance (also: bump into).

gaps.sentence: Hold ___ a moment — I'll check if he's in.
gaps.explanation: hold on = wait (especially on the phone).

gaps.sentence: She came ___ with a brilliant solution to the problem.
gaps.explanation: come up with = produce an idea/plan/solution.

gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
